[Third-price auction with 3 bidders has a symmetric linear equilibrium s(v)=a v. Best-response calculus gives a=2, so equilibrium bidding function is s(v)=2v. With my private value v=$32, bidding $64 (2*32) maximizes expected payoff under iid uniform values.]
